name: trip-planning-suite
description: End-to-end trip planning from live flight and hotel research through iterative itineraries, dynamic maps, route posters, and shareable PDFs.

interface.shortDescription: 从机酒研究到地图、线路图和 PDF 的完整旅行工作流
interface.longDescription: 一个分层调用子 Skill 的旅行规划套件，支持多出发地机票比较、酒店选择、对话迭代、详细 Markdown、动态地图、可编辑 HTML 线路海报和高清 PDF 交付。
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $trip-planning-orchestrator to plan this trip end to end and keep the itinerary, map, route poster, and PDF synchronized.
